'''Imperial Procurement''' was an organizational branch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the department's deputy head was [[Churg Anaris Hej]]. Hej filed a report regarding the stockpiling of [[Beskar/Legends|beskar]] metal, and the possible difficulties in finding [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] metalsmiths willing to work for the Empire.
